findings.description: The Lambda environment variables embed an AWS access key ID and secret access key in the Terraform configuration. This exposes the credentials through source control, Terraform state, deployment configuration, and Lambda environment access, and could enable unauthorized AWS API access if they are valid.
The function uses the end-of-life Node.js 12.x runtime, which no longer receives security updates and increases exposure to known runtime vulnerabilities.
